about.title: A studio where every flower is made by hand
about.text:
Giftoria Atelier is a gift studio: "atelier" is the French word for an artist's workshop, and that is how we work. We work one stem at a time, with care for every detail.

The studio began in a single room at home, where the first bouquet was twisted from pipe cleaners and yarn.

Today every bouquet, keychain and gajra is still made after you order, in the colours you choose, and delivered across Multan.

policies.howto:
1. Add products to your cart and enter your delivery details.
2. Place the order to receive your order number.
3. Pay the full amount by JazzCash, Easypaisa or bank transfer.
4. Send your order number and payment screenshot on WhatsApp.
5. We confirm your order, make it by hand and deliver it to your door in Multan.
policies.refund:
Every item is made to order, and your payment covers the materials.

• Cancel before work begins and your payment is refunded in full.
• Once work has begun, the payment is non-refundable.
• If an item arrives damaged or incorrect, send a photo within 48 hours. We will remake it or refund you.
policies.terms:
• We deliver within Multan only.
• Prices are in Pakistani Rupees and may change.
• Because every piece is handmade, colour and size may vary slightly.
• Delivery times may vary with traffic and weather.
• An order is confirmed once full payment is received. The inDrive delivery fare is paid to the rider.
policies.privacy: Your name, phone number and address are used only to process and deliver your order. We do not share them with anyone except the rider who delivers your order.
